definitionZh: CSS外侧的形状属性定义了一个形状——可能是非矩形的——周围,相邻的内线内容应该包起来。 默认情况下,内线内容会环绕它的边框;形状外侧提供了一种自定义这种包装的方法,使得可以围绕复杂的对象而不是长方形框来包裹文字.
sourceDefinition: The shape-outside CSS property defines a shape—which may be non-rectangular—around which adjacent inline content should wrap. By default, inline content wraps around its margin box; shape-outside provides a way to customize this wrapping, making it possible to wrap text around complex objects rather than rectangular boxes.
